module: Autosave of the level editor. A timer (preference files.autoSave.interval, 120 s by default) calls editor.autoSaveLevel() when files.autoSave.active is true, with a countdown in the status bar during files.autoSave.noticeInterval seconds. An "AutoSave Restore" modal window lets you restore the scene tree from /temp/level_autosaves/<level>/; it opens by itself if the editor did not close cleanly on that level, or via the windows menu.
notes: The restore copies the autosave folder over the level (editor.copyDirectory) then reopens the level: irreversible (the confirmation dialog says so).
The preference descriptions mention /settings/editor/autosaves while the code reads /temp/level_autosaves/: apparent inconsistency between help text and the path used.

Registered preferences (category files > autoSave): active (bool, false), saveBackupCopy (bool, false), interval (int, 120), noticeInterval (int, 10), maxAutoSaveCountPerSession (int, 3), counter (int, 1, hidden).
If interval is lowered below noticeInterval, noticeInterval is brought down to interval; the reverse is also corrected.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every editor frame: shows the restore window if needed, decrements the timer, displays the warning and triggers editor.autoSaveLevel() when it reaches 0.

dtReal.desc: Real frame time (s), used for the timer.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Initializes the timer with files.autoSave.interval and adds the "AutoSave Restore" entry to the windows menu.

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes: resets the timer for files.autoSave.interval and keeps noticeInterval <= interval.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Editor preferences registration hook: declares the "files" category and the "autoSave" subcategory.
